_phase_c_snapshot_scope: paths matching PHASE_C_CAUSAL_PATHS + transitively referenced components.schemas (Plan v3 §2.1 / §12)

post.summary: Phase C C1 — Bayesian backdoor ATE estimation (PyMC posterior + 95% HDI)
post.description:
Compute a Bayesian posterior over the ATE for the (treatment,
outcome) pair on the supplied data via PyMC NUTS sampling.

Complements Phase B B2a's frequentist LinearDML by providing
full posterior characterisation (HDI + samples) instead of point
+ frequentist CI. The two approaches are reported side-by-side
in Paper 3 (methodology paper) per the "dual Bayesian–frequentist
reporting" framing.

Method families (C1 MVP):

- ``bayesian_backdoor`` (default) — Linear regression with
  weakly informative priors (Gelman et al. 2008 style) over the
  treatment coefficient. Returns posterior samples + 95% HDI.
- ``bayesian_dml`` — Reserved for Phase C C2+; 422-rejected with
  ``code='method_reserved'`` (mirrors B2a's
  ``method_family_reserved`` pattern).

Sync-mode requests with inline row count > 10,000 are
422-rejected at validator time; use ``mode='async_job'`` for
larger datasets.

Evidence level rules:

- ``validated`` — r_hat < 1.01 AND ESS > 400 AND n_divergent == 0
  AND HDI excludes zero AND backdoor adjustment set non-empty
- ``supported`` — r_hat < 1.05 AND ESS > 100 AND HDI excludes zero
- ``planned`` — otherwise (e.g. small_sample, no backdoor, or
  poor sampler diagnostics)

Sampling timing: typically 10-30s with a C++ compiler available
(pytensor compiled mode); 30-90s on pytensor's Python fallback
when no compiler is present. The lazy PyMC import means
importing this router does not pay the ~5-10s PyMC import cost.

post.summary: Phase C C2 — distribution-free conformal prediction intervals (split + Mondrian variants)
post.description:
Compute distribution-free prediction intervals at the requested
(1-α) coverage level for new observations.

Method families (C2 MVP):

- ``split_conformal`` (default) — Lei & Wasserman 2014. Marginal
  coverage guarantee P(Y ∈ Ĉ(X)) ≥ 1-α. Requires no
  distributional assumption beyond exchangeability between
  training and calibration splits.
- ``mondrian_conformal`` — Vovk et al. 2005. Stratified
  conformal: per-stratum quantile gives conditional coverage
  guarantee P(Y ∈ Ĉ(X) | stratum=s) ≥ 1-α within each stratum.
  Requires ``stratum_variable`` to be set (validator-enforced).
  Strata with fewer than ``n_min_per_stratum`` calibration
  samples fall back to the marginal quantile with a
  ``small_stratum`` warning.

Implementation: custom split-conformal (~50 LOC numpy) with no
``mapie`` / ``crepes`` dependency. Internal OLS regressor fit on
training split; residuals computed on calibration split; (1-α)
quantile (``method='higher'`` for finite-sample correction).

Evidence level rules (C2 Design §3.4):
- ``validated`` — n_cal ≥ 30 AND marginal_quantile < 50% of
  outcome std AND (for Mondrian) all strata have n ≥
  n_min_per_stratum
- ``supported`` — n_cal ≥ 10
- ``planned`` — otherwise

post.summary: Phase C C4 — end-to-end SER uncertainty propagation (D' × G' → SER posterior with optional mediation chain)
post.description:
Propagate input posterior samples on D' and G' (and optionally
the κ-mediation proportion) through the SER geometric-mean
aggregator, returning a credibility band on the final SER.

Operationalises Paper 1 §3.6's 2×10^5 Monte Carlo propagation
as a typed REST surface. Phase B B2a reports SER point + CI
on a single fit; this C4 endpoint takes **posterior samples**
and returns a **posterior** on SER.

Inputs (operator pre-computes):
- ``d_prime_posterior`` (required) — typically the output of
  /bayesian_estimate run with D' as outcome.
- ``g_prime_posterior`` (required) — same, but G' as outcome.
- ``mediation_proportion_posterior`` (optional) — output of
  /mediation C3 bayesian_mediation branch's proportion
  samples (computed internally from NIE/total posterior
  products; operator may need to extract these from the
  bayesian mediation engine's cache or re-derive from
  response.decomposition / response.ci_lower / response.ci_upper).

Propagation method:
- ``monte_carlo_resample`` (default) — n=10,000 default
  Monte Carlo draws; robust to D'/G' sample-size mismatch.
- ``pairwise_alignment`` — requires len(D') == len(G') and
  treats the i-th draw of each as a joint sample.

Evidence-level rules (C4 §_classify_evidence):
- ``validated`` — n_d ≥ 500 AND n_g ≥ 500 AND n_propagated
  ≥ 5000 AND SER credibility band excludes 0
- ``supported`` — n_d ≥ 100 AND n_g ≥ 100 AND SER band low > 0
- ``planned`` — otherwise

Runtime: ~30-100ms typically (no PyMC sampling; pure numpy
quantile + sqrt operations).

r_hat.title: R Hat
r_hat.description: Gelman-Rubin convergence statistic. < 1.01 indicates chains have mixed. 1.05+ indicates problems.

effective_sample_size.title: Effective Sample Size
effective_sample_size.description: Effective number of independent posterior draws. Should be > 400 for stable HDI estimation.

n_divergent.title: N Divergent
n_divergent.description: Number of divergent transitions during NUTS sampling. Should be 0; >0 indicates sampler pathology (often a prior misspecification or model identification issue).

BayesianDiagnostics.title: BayesianDiagnostics
BayesianDiagnostics.description:
PyMC NUTS sampler diagnostics returned alongside posterior.

Quality criteria (per C1 design §3.4):
- r_hat < 1.01 → chains well-mixed
- effective_sample_size > 400 → enough independent draws
- n_divergent == 0 → no sampler pathologies

method.title: Method
method.description: Bayesian estimator family. C1 ships ``bayesian_backdoor`` only; ``bayesian_dml`` is reserved for Phase C C2+ and rejected at runtime with HTTP 422 ``code='method_reserved'``.

precomputed_estimand.description: Echo of /identify response's estimand_handle. When provided, /bayesian_estimate skips re-running identification and uses the recorded adjustment set verbatim.

n_chains.title: N Chains
n_chains.description: Number of NUTS chains. Default 2 (minimum for r_hat computation). Higher chains improve convergence detection but multiply runtime.

n_draws.title: N Draws
n_draws.description: Posterior draws per chain after tuning. Default 1000 → 2000 total samples with n_chains=2.

target_accept.title: Target Accept
target_accept.description: NUTS step-size adaptation target. Higher → more conservative, fewer divergences, slower.

prior_treatment_mean.title: Prior Treatment Mean
prior_treatment_mean.description: Prior mean on the treatment-effect coefficient. Default 0 (null hypothesis as prior centre). Override when domain knowledge supports a non-null prior.

prior_treatment_sd.title: Prior Treatment Sd
prior_treatment_sd.description: Prior standard deviation on the treatment-effect coefficient. Default 1.0 (weakly informative on standardised-scale data; widen if data un-standardised).

prior_covariate_sd.title: Prior Covariate Sd
prior_covariate_sd.description: Prior standard deviation on covariate coefficients. Default 5.0 (broad).

prior_noise_sd.title: Prior Noise Sd
prior_noise_sd.description: Prior scale on the HalfNormal noise distribution. Default 1.0.

random_seed.title: Random Seed
random_seed.description: PyMC sampler seed. Default 42 to match Paper 1 convention. Different seeds give different posterior samples but same posterior mean within ~5%.

n_min_per_stratum.title: N Min Per Stratum
n_min_per_stratum.description: Honest power floor. If effective per-stratum sample size falls below this, response is forced to evidence_level='planned' and a 'small_sample' warning is added — no error raised, because n=4 demonstrator experiments are valid.

confidence_level.title: Confidence Level
confidence_level.description: HDI probability mass. 0.95 → 95% Highest Density Interval. Reported as ate_hdi_95 in response.

BayesianEstimateRequest.title: BayesianEstimateRequest
BayesianEstimateRequest.description:
Phase C C1 — Bayesian backdoor ATE estimation request.

Wraps PyMC NUTS sampler with weakly informative priors over the
treatment-effect coefficient (the parameter of interest). The
posterior over this coefficient is interpreted as the ATE
posterior.

When ``precomputed_estimand`` is provided, the engine reuses the
Phase B /identify endpoint's adjustment set verbatim (matching
the precomputed_estimand pattern from B2a).

ate_point.title: Ate Point
ate_point.description: Posterior mean of the ATE. Backward-compat with B.2 estimate response field naming.

ate_posterior_mean.title: Ate Posterior Mean
ate_posterior_mean.description: Explicit posterior mean of the ATE. Equals ate_point. Provided for clarity in Bayesian contexts.

ate_hdi_low.title: Ate Hdi Low
ate_hdi_low.description: Lower bound of the 95% Highest Density Interval (HDI). When confidence_level != 0.95, this is the lower bound of the configured HDI.

ate_hdi_high.title: Ate Hdi High
ate_hdi_high.description: Upper bound of the HDI. ``ate_hdi_high - ate_hdi_low`` is the HDI width.

ate_posterior_sd.title: Ate Posterior Sd
ate_posterior_sd.description: Posterior standard deviation of the ATE. Bayesian analog of the frequentist SE.

ate_posterior_samples.title: Ate Posterior Samples
ate_posterior_samples.description: Flat list of all posterior samples across chains. Length = n_chains * n_draws. Used by Batch C4 uncertainty pipeline.

n_samples_observed.title: N Samples Observed
n_samples_observed.description: Number of rows in the input dataset.

backdoor_variables.title: Backdoor Variables
backdoor_variables.description: Adjustment set used for backdoor identification (either echo of precomputed_estimand or freshly derived from the DAG).

request_fingerprint.title: Request Fingerprint
request_fingerprint.description: SHA-256 hex of the canonicalised request body. Used by downstream pipelines for cross-endpoint linkage.

BayesianEstimateResponse.title: BayesianEstimateResponse
BayesianEstimateResponse.description:
Phase C C1 — Bayesian backdoor ATE response.

Returns posterior over the treatment-effect coefficient
(interpreted as the ATE posterior under backdoor adjustment).
Includes point summary (mean), uncertainty (HDI + SD), full
posterior samples for downstream uncertainty propagation in
Batch C4, and sampler diagnostics.

inline.title: Inline
inline.description: Inline row list; each dict is one record with numeric values. Up to 200k rows. For larger datasets use batch_query_key.

batch_query_key.title: Batch Query Key
batch_query_key.description: Server-side handle to a previously-registered dataset (e.g. SHA-256 prefix of a batch DB cursor). Phase B MVP does not implement the backing store; reserved for Phase G.

CausalData.title: CausalData
CausalData.description:
Tabular data carrier.

Exactly one of ``inline`` or ``batch_query_key`` must be provided.
``fingerprint`` is mandatory and lets identify-verdicts be audited
against the dataset they were issued for.

CausalWarning.title: CausalWarning
CausalWarning.description: Operator-visible warning record carried in response payloads.

alpha.title: Alpha
alpha.description: Significance level. (1 - alpha) is the coverage guarantee. Default 0.05 → 95% prediction interval.

calibration_fraction.title: Calibration Fraction
calibration_fraction.description: Fraction of data held out for calibration (quantile estimation). Default 0.3.

stratum_variable.title: Stratum Variable
stratum_variable.description: Stratum column name (required when method='mondrian_conformal'). Must be a column in data.inline.

new_observations.title: New Observations
new_observations.description: Optional list of new x rows to predict on. Each row must contain all backdoor variables + treatment (+ stratum_variable for Mondrian). When None, only calibration stats are returned.

n_min_per_stratum.title: N Min Per Stratum
n_min_per_stratum.description: Honest power floor for Mondrian. Strata with fewer than n_min cal samples fall back to the marginal quantile + a 'small_stratum' warning.

ConformalPredictRequest.title: ConformalPredictRequest
ConformalPredictRequest.description:
Phase C C2 — Conformal prediction request.

Splits the data into training (fit OLS regressor) + calibration
(compute residual quantile). Predicts on optional
new_observations with distribution-free (1-α) intervals.

predictions.title: Predictions
predictions.description: One entry per row in request.new_observations. Empty if no new_observations were supplied.

marginal_quantile.title: Marginal Quantile
marginal_quantile.description: The (1-α) quantile of |residuals| on the marginal calibration set. The marginal split-conformal interval half-width.

median_interval_width.title: Median Interval Width
median_interval_width.description: Median width of the prediction intervals on the new observations. None if no new_observations supplied.

strata_used.title: Strata Used
strata_used.description: Stratum value → number of calibration samples in that stratum. None for marginal split-conformal.

per_stratum_quantiles.title: Per Stratum Quantiles
per_stratum_quantiles.description: Stratum value → (1-α) quantile of |residuals| within that stratum. None for marginal split-conformal.

ConformalPredictResponse.title: ConformalPredictResponse
ConformalPredictResponse.description: Phase C C2 — conformal prediction response.

interval_low.title: Interval Low
interval_low.description: Lower bound of the (1-α) prediction interval.

stratum.title: Stratum
stratum.description: Stratum value for this observation (Mondrian only). None for marginal split-conformal.

ConformalPrediction.title: ConformalPrediction
ConformalPrediction.description: Single conformal prediction for one new observation.

DagEdge.title: DagEdge
DagEdge.description: Directed edge between two declared nodes.

bos_field_ref.title: Bos Field Ref
bos_field_ref.description: Optional dotted reference to the Phase A schema field this node represents, e.g. 'ser.SerComputeRequest.dm_in'. Used for DAG-library audit + B0.7's time-indexed DSL (e.g. '@step_at_m3_boundary').

source.title: Source
source.description: Provenance of the DAG: 'hand' (operator-authored), 'auto_causal_learn' (auto-discovery), 'hybrid' (skeleton + auto-validate), or 'library' (curated, e.g. B0.7's PHASE_B_DAGS/*.json).

provenance_meta.title: Provenance Meta
provenance_meta.description: Per-edge provenance. Keys use format 'src->dst'. Lets a hybrid DAG record which edges came from the hand skeleton vs the auto-validation pass vs the curated library. Optional; recommended when source == 'hybrid'.

DagSpec.title: DagSpec
DagSpec.description:
Directed acyclic graph plus provenance metadata.

Validators enforce:

- every edge endpoint references a declared node,
- no self-loops,
- graph is acyclic; on violation the smallest cycle is reported
  so the operator can act surgically.

IdentifiedEstimandHandle.title: IdentifiedEstimandHandle
IdentifiedEstimandHandle.description:
Echo of /identify's verdict, sufficient for /estimate to reuse
the same adjustment strategy without re-running identification.

invalid_samples_dropped.title: Invalid Samples Dropped
invalid_samples_dropped.description: Number of propagated samples dropped due to invalid SER computation (e.g. negative product before sqrt).

d_prime_posterior.title: D Prime Posterior
d_prime_posterior.description: Posterior samples of D' (dry-matter reduction normalised). Typically the output of /bayesian_estimate on D' as the outcome. Length 100-10000 is typical.

g_prime_posterior.title: G Prime Posterior
g_prime_posterior.description: Posterior samples of G' (nitrogen recovery normalised). Same source pattern as d_prime_posterior.

mediation_proportion_posterior.title: Mediation Proportion Posterior
mediation_proportion_posterior.description: Optional posterior samples of the κ-mediation proportion. When supplied, the response includes proportion_mediated_band. Typically the output of /mediation C3 bayesian_mediation branch's proportion_mediated samples.

method.title: Method
method.description: How to combine D' and G' samples. ``monte_carlo_resample`` (default): resample N independent draws from each posterior, combine pointwise. Robust to different sample sizes between D' and G'. ``pairwise_alignment``: requires len(D') == len(G') and treats the i-th draw of each as a joint sample. Use when D' and G' came from the same joint posterior.

alpha.title: Alpha
alpha.description: Credibility level. Output band uses [alpha/2, median, 1-alpha/2] quantiles. Default 0.05 → 95% credibility.

n_propagated_samples.title: N Propagated Samples
n_propagated_samples.description: Number of Monte Carlo draws to generate (only used when method='monte_carlo_resample'). Default 10,000. Set higher for tighter quantile estimates at the cost of runtime.

UncertaintyPipelineRequest.title: UncertaintyPipelineRequest
UncertaintyPipelineRequest.description:
Phase C C4 — end-to-end SER uncertainty propagation request.

Operator supplies posterior samples (typically from
/bayesian_estimate C1) for the two SER components D' and G';
optionally also the κ-mediation proportion (typically from
/mediation C3 bayesian_mediation branch).

The engine propagates these through:
    SER = sqrt(D' × G')
    proportion_mediated = NIE / total  (when mediation samples)
using Monte Carlo resampling (default) or pairwise alignment.

final_ser_point.title: Final Ser Point
final_ser_point.description: Posterior mean of SER = sqrt(D' × G').

final_ser_posterior_samples.title: Final Ser Posterior Samples
final_ser_posterior_samples.description: Full propagated SER samples. Length = n_propagated_samples.

proportion_mediated_band.description: Credibility band on the κ-mediation proportion. Present only when mediation_proportion_posterior was supplied in the request.

pearl_consistency_residual.title: Pearl Consistency Residual
pearl_consistency_residual.description: Computed only when mediation_proportion_posterior is supplied. |E[proportion_mediated] - estimated| from samples. NOT enforced — informational.

UncertaintyPipelineResponse.title: UncertaintyPipelineResponse
UncertaintyPipelineResponse.description: Phase C C4 — end-to-end SER posterior.
